body_markdown:
In its fourth year, the Grand National Truck Show at the Pomona Fairplex pitted 10 amazingly crafted trucks in a battle for the title of World’s Most Beautiful Truck. The contenders came from some familiar shops, and some of the owners’ names might be familiar as well, especially to those who pay attention to the Grand National Roadster Show or the Sacramento Autorama. This year, the title of World’s Most Beautiful Truck was bestowed upon Gary Holyoak’s stunning metallic charcoal 1963 Chevy C10.


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


This shortbed fleetside truck has been in the Holyoak family since they bought it used in 1969. After a long life of dependable service, Gary Holyoak decided to transform his father’s former workhorse into a high-performance machine. It rides on a Roadster Shop chassis and is powered by an LS3 from Don Hardy Engines linked to a Tremec six-speed manual transmission. HS Customs in Logan, Utah, is responsible for all of the amazing bodywork, including the reshaped engine bay that mimics the shape of the hood.


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


Bob Florine (second from left) of ARP presented Gary Holyoak with a trophy and a $12,500 check for taking home the World’s Most Beautiful Truck title. ARP will be doubling its sponsorship next year, as the Grand National Truck Show will offer two top awards, divided into 1959 and earlier trucks and those built in 1960 and later.


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


Contrasting the understated charcoal finish on the outside is bold red upholstery by Seams Impossible Interiors in Grantsville, Utah.


[Brandan Gillogly](https://www.hagerty.com/media/author/brandan-gillogly/)


## The Contenders:


The Grand National Truck Show brought out vans, minitrucks, and 4x4s from all over America and had[previous winners of America’s Most Beautiful Truck](https://www.hagerty.com/media/events/1941-willys-crowned-2025-worlds-most-beautiful-truck/) on display. Still, the big draw is always the newly completed builds that debut and compete for the trophy. Here are the other nine pickups that Gary Holyoak had to contend with. As you can see, the level of craftsmanship was outstanding.
